subject: FastCart service interruption — confirmation & remedy proposal
messages:
From: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@fastcart.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@fastcart.com
Date: 2029-05-02T16:12:00Z
Subject: Service interruption May 2 — potential SLA impact

Hi Grace,

We observed a service interruption affecting our checkout API traffic to Redwood between ~2029-05-02T14:03:00Z and 2029-05-02T14:28:00Z (approx). During that window we saw request failures and elevated 503s and spikes in latency that caused ~7% of checkouts to fail. Our billing team told me to open a formal SLA inquiry per section 4.2 of the contract.

Can you confirm the exact platform-side downtime window (or degraded-window) and whether this qualifies under the 99.95% availability SLA for May? We need:
- Exact impacted window (start/end) and affected region
- Any immediate evidence you can share (aggregate error counts, region-level telemetry)
- Expected timeline to receive a post-incident report / remediation plan

We're also attaching a short list of failed request IDs and timestamps on our side, which may help correlate (attached). Please let me know who on your side will be the point of contact for evidence requests and an SLA credit discussion.

Thanks — we need to reconcile this before FastCart's monthly close next week.

Jamie Torres
Head of Ops, FastCart
jamie.torres@fastcart.com
+1 415 555 0189

Attachments: transaction-samples-ids.txt (list of sample request IDs)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@fastcart.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2029-05-02T16:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Service interruption May 2 — potential SLA impact

Thanks for the heads-up, Jamie — sorry for the trouble this caused your customers. I'm opening an incident inquiry and will own the SLA coordination. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) I'll confirm the exact impacted window after our trace collection completes. Can you confirm whether the sample IDs you sent are for the US-West region? If you can also provide 3 representative request IDs with timestamps (you already sent the sample file; thanks), that helps our correlation.

2) Our initial telemetry shows a short spike in 503s across our US cluster around 2029-05-02T14:05–14:22Z but we need to pull raw traces to be definitive.

3) Immediate point people: me (Grace O'Connor) for customer communication and SLA, Marissa Cole (SRE lead) for traces and log bundles, and Vivek Kulkarni (Contracts) if we need to discuss remedy/credits.

What we'll do: collect raw traces and host them in a zipped bundle, correlate to your sample IDs, and propose an eligibility assessment within 24–36 business hours. If eligible, we'll propose a credit calculation and a postmortem timeline (RCA draft within 72 hours).

Can you confirm receipt of this and the sample IDs file? Also, upload any relevant CloudFront/edge logs if available — those sometimes help.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2029-05-03T09:12:00Z
Subject: Internal: FastCart SLA eligibility assessment and remedy proposal (FAST-8421)

Marissa / Vivek / Lauren — looping you in with the traces Jamie uploaded. TL;DR: Customer reports ~25 minutes of elevated 503s/latency in US-West on 2029-05-02; their samples map to our region. I pulled initial metrics: a control-plane spike triggered a transient routing inconsistency which caused an 18–24 minute window of degraded responses for a subset of tenants.

Questions and suggested next steps: 
- Marissa: can you confirm the precise start/end times after you finish trace stitching and produce an error-count table per minute? We need the authoritative incident window and a short evidence bundle for the customer.
- Vivek / Lauren: if the window is confirmed as >15 minutes total degraded service for FastCart and affects production traffic, per contract section 4.2 we should consider a proportional credit. I propose we reserve a preliminary credit of 10% of May usage for FastCart pending final calculation (we can adjust after we verify exact error counts). Please advise if that aligns with legal/finance guardrails.
- Timeline: aim to provide the customer an evidence bundle + preliminary credit proposal by EOD 2029-05-03 and an RCA draft within 72 hours.

Attachments: link to traces (internal): JIRA SVC-9812 has raw bundles; I'll upload the customer-facing bundle once Marissa confirms.

Grace
Senior CSM, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, legal@fastcart.com
Date: 2029-05-03T15:30:00Z
Subject: FastCart — incident confirmation, proposed remedy, and RCA timeline (FAST-8421)

Hi Jamie — thanks for your patience. We completed our trace reconciliation and here are the items we can confirm and offer today.

1) Confirmed impacted window: 2029-05-02T14:04:12Z to 2029-05-02T14:22:55Z (US-West region). During that period we measured elevated 5xx responses affecting ~6.9% of FastCart's requests routed through the cluster. Raw trace correlation and the per-minute error table are attached.

2) Evidence bundle (attached): fastcart-traces-20290502.zip contains the stitched traces and an errors-by-minute CSV. Also attached: transaction-samples-ids.txt (your original list) and a customer-facing RCA draft (rca-draft-FASTCART-20290503.pdf).

3) Preliminary remedy proposal: based on the measured impact and our SLA (section 4.2), Redwood proposes a provisional credit equal to 10% of FastCart's Redwood charges for May 2029. This is subject to final verification of token/usage alignment and will be reflected on your May invoice or as an account credit upon agreement. If you prefer a dollar-amount reconciliation instead of a percentage, we can provide that once finance maps usage.

4) RCA timeline & next steps: we will publish a final RCA with root cause and long-term mitigations within 72 hours (target: 2029-05-06T15:30:00Z). At that time we'll also include action items and dates for mitigation rollout. Please review the attached RCA draft and tell us if you want any sensitive details redacted for sharing with your legal/finance teams.

If this provisional credit works for FastCart, reply with approval and we'll route the credit through our billing queue and confirm ETA for application.

Apologies again for the disruption — we understand the customer impact and are treating this as a priority.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: fastcart-traces-20290502.zip, transaction-samples-ids.txt, rca-draft-FASTCART-20290503.pdf
